scope: Resolve predictors for the fixed audited candidate frame; do not revise endpoint selection or eligibility membership. All existing frozen features/models remain read-only.

diagnosis_duration.retain: Keep every valid strict-audit diagnosis_duration_years unchanged.
diagnosis_duration.fallback_trigger: Only missing duration with diagnosis_history selection_status=no_timed_record. Do not rescue an invalid or conflicting selected recent record.
diagnosis_duration.historical_sources: Native PD_Diagnosis_History SC/BL forms with valid INFODT at or before the clinical index; no maximum look-back for this static historical date.
diagnosis_duration.accept: At least one eligible historical form; every such form has valid PDDXDT, all PDDXDT months identical, and diagnosis_month <= form_month <= index_month. Derived (index-diagnosis)/12 must be 0..80 years.
diagnosis_duration.reject: Any invalid/missing date, contradiction or unavailable eligible form leaves the optional predictor missing with a reason. Future diagnosis/history forms cannot rescue it.
diagnosis_duration.no_medical_inference: Do not substitute symptom onset, age at diagnosis, treatment onset or current diagnosis status.

age.fallback_trigger: Missing or conflicting strict age only.
age.birth_source: Native SCREEN SC/BL demographics with valid INFODT <= index. All eligible pre-index SCREEN records must supply the same valid BIRTHDT month. TRANS/later records cannot supply the value.
age.derivation: Round (index_month-birth_month)/12 to one decimal using decimal ROUND_HALF_UP; accept only age18..110. This is a month-derived age estimate, not exact birthday precision.
age.corroboration: Require unique unified BL visit month equal to the audit baseline reference month, and unique finite unified BL age_at_visit. Adjust that corroborating age by(index-reference)/12; its distance from the unrounded birth-derived index age must be <= 1/12+0.05 years. Require at least one valid native BL AGE_AT_VISIT, similarly shifted to index, within that same tolerance. The tolerance accounts for monthly dates and one-decimal native ages; do not select or average a conflicting native age.
age.failure: If any gate fails, leave age missing; later dates/ages and validation outcomes cannot adjudicate.
age.preservation: No rounding or replacement of previously valid strict age values; retain all age-conflict flags and source-row provenance.

sensitivity: Preserve original strict-window predictor values in a separate variant on the same locked endpoint membership. Also define complete-core subsets after resolution and sensitivity excluding all newly age-resolved participants.
prohibited: No model fitting or transformation fitting
